doc.title: Ron Carter interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 17, 1999

title: Deciding to move to New York
summary: Rochester musicians told Carter New York always has room for a good bass player, so he moved in August after graduating.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: New York seemed inevitable for you after Rochester?

Well having done some freelance work at the Ridgecrest Inn club and met some musicians who would talk after the gigs and between classes, they just said New York always has room for a good bass player. I should come to New York and try my hand. So when I graduated in June, I moved to New York in August.
